NoteNlpAccessor::mask_times¶

Back to Note NLP Accessor API Reference

Signature¶

Note NoteNlpAccessor::mask_times() const

Replace Valid Clock Shapes As One Unit¶

mask_times() replaces clock expressions with [TIME]. It recognizes 24-hour H:MM/HH:MM forms from 0:00 through 23:59, and 12-hour forms from 1am through 12pm, optionally including minutes and one space before the suffix.

Form

Examples

Rejected boundary

24-hour

00:00, 9:05, 23:59

24:00, 12:60

12-hour

7pm, 07:05 AM, 12:00pm

0pm, 19:30pm

The full suffixed form is replaced atomically; 07:05 AM does not leave the suffix behind. Seconds, timezone suffixes, and prose such as noon are not part of this grammar. Use broad number masking only if those numeric fragments should be hidden independently.

The operation accepts Text, returns a fresh Text Note with identical shape, and does not mutate the receiver. It is idempotent, propagates undefined input, and preserves defined empty shapes. Cells without digits bypass recognition.

Example 1: 24-Hour And 12-Hour Forms¶

std::cout << pluss::note::print(
    pluss::note::make({"00:00", "23:59", "7pm", "07:05 AM"})
        .nlp().mask_times()) << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[4], dim=1, numel=4, encoding=utf8)
["[TIME]", "[TIME]", "[TIME]", "[TIME]"]

Example 2: Invalid Ranges Stay Visible¶

std::cout << pluss::note::print(
    pluss::note::make({"keep 24:00 19:30pm 12:60; mask 12:00pm"})
        .nlp().mask_times()) << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[1], dim=1, numel=1, encoding=utf8)
["keep 24:00 19:30pm 12:60; mask [TIME]"]

Example 3: Empty, Undefined, And Bytes¶

const auto empty = pluss::note::make(std::vector<std::string>{})
                       .nlp().mask_times();
std::cout << "times empty dim=" << empty.dim()
          << " numel=" << empty.numel() << '\n';
std::cout << "times undefined=" << std::boolalpha
          << pluss::Note::undefined().nlp().mask_times().defined() << '\n';
try {
  (void)pluss::note::bytes(
      std::vector<std::string>{"7pm"}, std::array<std::int64_t, 1>{1})
      .nlp().mask_times();
} catch (const pluss::Error&) { std::cout << "times Bytes: rejected\n"; }

Output¶

times empty dim=1 numel=0
times undefined=false
times Bytes: rejected

See Also¶

  • mask_dates: mask calendar-shaped spans.

  • mask_numbers: mask numeric fragments regardless of clock validity.

  • mask_pii: apply time masking in the standard multi-category order.
